provenance.memory_method: peak macOS phys_footprint of a fresh worker process (both libraries warmed on the same 30-row slice), sampled by the parent with proc_pid_rusage about every 0.5 ms while the fit repeats for >= 0.5 s, minus the footprint just before. tracemalloc_peak_bytes is a separate fit and covers Python/NumPy host allocations only.
